title: Landing Mat Set (Fiber-Reinforced Polymer (FRP) Mat Set) and Components
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY.TROOP SUPPORT CONSTRUCTION & EQUIPMENT.DLA TROOP SUPPORT
detail_text: Pursuant to Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 10, the Defense Logistics Agency is issuing this Sources Sought Notice as a means of conducting market research to identify interest in and the resources to support requirements for the following National Stock Numbers (NSNs): Landing Mat -- NSN: 5680-01-701-5374 Upper Joining Bushing and Bolt -- NSN: 5306-01-701-5898 Anchor Bushings -- NSN: 5365-01-700-9608 Half Mat Panel with Lower Bushings -- NSN: 5680-01-700-9352 Half Anchor Panel -- NSN: 5680-01-700-9359 Full Mat Panel with Lower Bushings -- NSN: 5680-01-701-5375 Full Anchor Panel -- NSN: 5680-01-701-5376 The requirements shall be manufactured in accordance with Detail Specification, MIL-DTL-32807. This Sources Sought Notice is issued for information and planning purposes and does not constitute a solicitation nor is this notice a Request for Quote (RFQ), Request for Bid (RFB) or a Request for Proposal (RFP). This notice should not be construed as a commitment by DLA Troop Support for any purpose. Submission of any information in response to this market survey is purely voluntary. The Government assumes no financial responsibility for any cost incurred. The Government will NOT pay for any information submitted by respondents in response to this Sources Sought Notice. If a solicitation would result, it would be synopsized on the “Contract Opportunities” website at SAM.gov and it would be the Offeror’s responsibility to monitor the “Contract Opportunities” website for any such notices. Interested contractors are requested to review and return a completed Market Survey (attached) no later than 3:00PM, Tuesday, April 21, 2026. To submit a completed survey or for additional information or assistance, contact Asheai Patterson by email at asheai.patterson@dla.mil.
